usage.outputShape: JSON object at body root: body.id, body.displayName.text, body.formattedAddress, body.location.{latitude,longitude}, body.types[], body.primaryType (plus optional rating, websiteUri, phone, openingHours, etc. when present)
quirks: placeId must be a real Google Place ID (e.g. ChIJN1t_tDeuEmsRUsoyG83frY4 = Google Sydney); it is a query param, not a path param
'partial' variant returns a trimmed field set; photos excluded by default via excludeFields=[photos]
Result fields are sparse — only id is guaranteed; other fields appear only when Google has the data for that place
usage.guide: Call GET https://stableenrich.dev/api/google-maps/place-details/partial with the required query param placeId set to a valid Google Place ID; optionally pass languageCode (default en) and excludeFields (default photos). Pay via x402 ($0.02 USDC on Base). The 200 JSON response is the place object at the root — read body.displayName.text for the name, body.formattedAddress for the address, body.location.latitude/longitude for coordinates, and body.types/primaryType for category. Only body.id is guaranteed; treat other fields as optional.
